ops.body: Spin-off ids, for navigation: the HOME-resolution split is 01ed7d3 (P1, 'installedApplicationPath resolves the app root from $HOME while daemonkit resolves agents from the passwd DB'), and the false-success updater is 31dcf12 (P2, 'Pre-12.22.4 updater reports success from brew's exit status'). This bug remains the root blocker of the three: fixing either sibling makes the failure honest, but only a packaging-layer change (cask postflight, self-healing host, or a helper install verb that really converges) makes brew delivery work.
